caption: A struck match stands upright in a holder and burns down, the flame creeping down the stick as the burnt part above it blackens and curls.

sa.check: A struck match stands upright in a holder.
The flame moves down the stick.
The part of the stick above the flame is blackened.
The flame shrinks as it nears the base.

pc.expect: The flame only travels downward along the stick and the wood it has passed stays black.
pc.fail: The flame climbs back up the stick; or a blackened part turns back to pale wood; or the flame jumps to a new place on the stick; or the burnt part straightens and lightens.

pc.expect: The burnt stick stays a thin stick that blackens and bends and does not turn into another material.
pc.fail: The burnt stick melts and drips; or the stick turns into another object; or the burnt part swells into a lump; or the stick stretches longer as it burns.

pc.expect: The flame points upward from the burning point whatever the stick's angle, and ash falls.
pc.fail: The flame points downward from the burning point; or hangs below the stick; or ash rises and stays aloft; or the flame lies flat against the stick with nothing blowing it.

pc.expect: The flame is at the boundary between the black part and the pale part and moves with it.
pc.fail: The flame burns in the middle of the pale part with black wood beyond it; or the flame burns above the blackened part on fresh wood; or the black part grows while the flame stays fixed at the head; or the flame burns with no blackening behind it at all.

pc.expect: One match in one holder; the match shortens only by burning and stays in the holder.
pc.fail: A second flame appears on the stick; or a new match appears in the holder; or the flame detaches and floats; or the match passes through the holder.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The holder, the surface it stands on and the surroundings stay the same.
pc.fail: The holder changes shape; or the surface changes pattern; or the background changes between frames.
